Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> In Focus | National Joy Prime Bags another award at YIMGA Prime Celebrant 2026 Source : Myjoyonline 19 October 2026 3:55pm Audio By Carbonatix
Joy Prime has once again been recognised for its outstanding contribution to community development, youth empowerment and entertainment, earning a prestigious honour at the Youth In Me Ghana Awards (YIMGA) Prime Celebrant 2026.
The award underscores the channel’s commitment to impactful storytelling, innovative programming and the use of television as a powerful platform for inspiring positive change and making a meaningful difference in society.
Lawrence Nartey-Kornor, Channel Coordinator of Joy Prime, received the award on behalf of the channel, marking another significant milestone in its journey to inform, inspire and entertain audiences.
Over the past five years, YIMGA has established itself as a platform for recognising and celebrating exceptional young talents, innovators, media organisations and change makers whose contributions are making a difference across Ghana.
Joy Prime’s recognition in 2026 reflects its role in championing youth development, strengthening communities and delivering compelling entertainment content that connects with audiences nationwide.
Through its diverse programming, the channel continues to spotlight emerging talents, amplify important voices and tell stories that matter. Its commitment to engaging content extends beyond entertainment, creating opportunities for meaningful conversations and promoting positive social impact.
Beyond the Award, the recognition serves as a testament to the power of television to inspire change, nurture talent, strengthen communities and shape public discourse.
For Joy Prime, the honour is not only a celebration of collective achievement but also a renewed commitment to delivering content that informs, empowers, inspires and entertains. It reinforces the channel’s determination to remain a platform where creativity meets purpose and entertainment drives impact.
As Joy Prime continues to deepen its connection with viewers and expand its influence, the award stands as another milestone in its pursuit of excellence and its commitment to telling stories that matter.
Other distinguished recipients of the 2026 Prime Celebrant Awards included retired COP Mrs Gifty Anim-Botwe, actor Oscar Provencal, popularly known for his role as Inspector Bediako, actor Adjetey Annang, Professor Elsie Effah Kaufmann, veteran actor Fred Amugi, media personality Mikki Osei Berko, Kwan Pa Band, Dr Bright Terry, and the Buz Stop Boys, among others. Their recognition celebrates their respective contributions and impact across various fields.
